name: AmigaX - Workbench 1.3
label: AmigaX
description: The AmigaX scheduler page in AmigaOS Workbench 1.3 style, in its four colours: blue (#0055AA) for the desktop, white for windows and text, black (#000022) for outlines and text, orange (#FF8800) to highlight active items. The Topaz font, and the red-health banner as a Guru Meditation.

text.redHealth: Software Failure.   main does not build or pass its gate.   Dispatching is held.

css: /* The Workbench 1.3 palette, its four colours and nothing else. */
:root { --blue: #0055aa; --white: #ffffff; --black: #000022; --orange: #ff8800; }
html, body { background: var(--blue); }
body { margin: 0; color: var(--black); font-family: 'ThemeFont', 'Topaz a500a1000a2000', 'Topaz New', 'Topaz', 'Lucida Console', monospace;
font-size: 16px; line-height: 20px; -webkit-font-smoothing: none; font-smooth: never; }
/* The screen's title bar. */
.screen { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: var(--white); color: var(--black);
padding: 1px 8px; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--black); position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 5; }
.screen .t { flex: 1; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
/* The blue desktop, and white windows outlined in black. */
.desk { padding: 12px 16px; }
.win { background: var(--white); color: var(--black); border: 2px solid var(--black); margin: 0 0 14px; }
.bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--white); color: var(--black);
padding: 1px 6px; min-height: 18px; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--black); }
.bar b { flex: 1; font-weight: normal; }
.win:hover > .bar { background: var(--orange); }
.inner { padding: 8px 10px; }
.slots { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 14px; margin: 0 0 14px; }
.slots .win { margin: 0; min-width: 0; }
table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; }
td, th { text-align: left; padding: 2px 8px; vertical-align: top; border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--black); }
th { font-weight: normal; color: var(--blue); }
tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }
/* State words: blue for quiet, orange for what wants attention. */
.mute { color: var(--blue); } .ok { color: var(--black); } .warn { color: var(--orange); }
.bad { background: var(--orange); color: var(--black); padding: 0 4px; }
a { color: var(--black); text-decoration: underline; } a:hover { background: var(--orange); color: var(--black); }
code { color: var(--blue); font: inherit; }
/* Gadgets: white, outlined in black; orange while pointed at or pressed. */
.g { display: inline-block; position: relative; margin: 0 6px 4px 0; }
button { font: inherit; color: var(--black); background: var(--white); border: 2px solid var(--black); padding: 0 10px; cursor: pointer; }
button:hover, button:active { background: var(--orange); color: var(--black); }
button[disabled], button[disabled]:hover { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; background: var(--white); }
button.bad { background: var(--white); color: var(--black); border-color: var(--orange); padding: 0 10px; }
button.bad:hover { background: var(--orange); }
form.q { margin: 2px 0; } form.q input { font: inherit; width: 14em; margin: 0 4px; }
form.send { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-top: 6px; } form.send input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; font: inherit; }
.stats { margin: 2px 0 4px; } table.waiting td { vertical-align: top; } table.waiting td .g { margin-bottom: 0; }
dialog.settings { padding: 0; border: 2px solid var(--black); background: var(--white); color: var(--black); min-width: 24em; }
dialog.settings::backdrop { background: rgba(0, 0, 34, .45); }
dialog.settings label { display: block; margin: 6px 0; } dialog.settings label.lane { display: inline-block; margin-right: 12px; }
dialog.settings input:not([type]) { font: inherit; width: 30em; max-width: 100%; display: block; border: 2px solid var(--black); }
.g:hover { z-index: 20; }
.g:hover::after { content: attr(data-tip); position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: calc(100% + 6px); z-index: 20;
background: var(--white); color: var(--black); border: 2px solid var(--black); padding: 2px 6px;
width: max-content; max-width: 340px; white-space: normal; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--black); }
pre.log { margin: 4px 0 0; padding: 4px 6px; background: var(--white); color: var(--black); border: 2px solid var(--black);
overflow: visible; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: normal; overflow-wrap: anywhere;
font-family: 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 13px; line-height: 16px;
-webkit-font-smoothing: auto; font-smooth: auto; }
/* Main is red: a Guru Meditation, in the palette's own colours. */
.health-red { background: var(--black); color: var(--orange); border: 6px solid var(--orange); text-align: center;
padding: 10px; margin: 0 0 14px; animation: health-blink 1s steps(1) infinite; }
.health-red a { color: var(--orange); }
@keyframes health-blink { 50% { border-color: var(--black); } }
/* Phones: the page is drawn at the phone's own width. Tables keep their rows on one line and
scroll sideways inside their window instead of breaking every word. */
@media (max-width: 700px) {
.desk { padding: 8px; }
.inner { overflow-x: auto; }
td, th { white-space: nowrap; }
.screen { flex-wrap: wrap; }
.screen .t { white-space: normal; }
